interest_disclosed.trust_holding_selection_rationale: Three holdings of The Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust selected deliberately to exercise the trust-as-intermediate-entity modeling pattern (resolves spec open question #2 in favor of intermediate-entity, which the spec already leaned toward) without becoming a transcription exercise. Selection criteria: (1) value-shape diversity (all three are bounded ranges; no Over-$50M open-ended ranges in the picks because the value object's shape enum did not at the time support open-ended ranges, an open question this filing surfaced); (2) asset-class diversity (NYC commercial real estate via 845 UN LP; Trump Organization operations via DJT Operations I LLC; foreign property via Trump International Golf Links Doonbeg); (3) high public visibility (Trump World Tower, Doonbeg golf course are both well-known). Trump National Doral, Trump International Golf Links Scotland, Trump Tower Commercial LLC, Trump International Hotels Management LLC, and Trump National Golf Club Los Angeles were the 5 Over-$50M entities originally named in the eight-step roadmap as held-back; subsequent Fork G inspection (2026-05-23) found the actual Over-$50M Part 2 Exhibit A count is 22, of which Fork G wrote 10 (the original 5 + 5 overlapping with the Fork H prep Part 8 borrowing-entity set: 40 Wall Street LLC, Trump National Golf Club Colts Neck LLC, Trump National Golf Club Washington DC LLC, Trump Old Post Office LLC, Trump Park Avenue LLC). The remaining 12 Over-$50M rows defer to Fork I alongside the full Part 2 Exhibit A operating-entity backfill.
interest_disclosed.form_layout_notes: cp_filing_0003 uses the older OGE Form 278e (March 2014) layout, distinct from cp_filing_0001 / cp_filing_0002 (newer 278e). Differences relevant to future forks: (a) Part 2 is split across 'Exhibit A' (operating-entity disclosures, pp.3-16) and 'Exhibit B' (structural / ownership schedule referenced by Reference # column, pp.38-79); (b) Part 6 spans pp.20-26 with p.20 carrying Trump-direct bank accounts, an INVESTMENT IN GOLD line, two operating LLCs (WMTMF LLC, MBWT LLC), a 'JP MORGAN CLEARING CORP - BROKERAGE ACCOUNT - HOLDINGS' sub-section with one Global Fiber Technologies entry, a 'The Fred C. Trump December 16, 1976 Trust- F/B/O Donald J. Trump' sub-section with one JP Morgan Chase Savings Account, and a 'The Donald J Trump Revocable Trust' sub-section with four bank accounts; pp.21-26 host three J.P. Morgan-managed Family Trust shells ('Family Trust 1*', 'Family Trust 2*', 'Family Trust 3*') containing ~103 pooled investment / treasury / cash items collectively; (c) Part 3 (Filer's Employment Agreements) at p17 discloses 2 pension-plan participations (Screen Actors Guild-Producers and AFTRA Retirement Fund); Part 4 (Filer's Sources of Compensation) at p18 is N/A; Part 5 (Spouse's Employment) at p19 discloses 6 Melania entities (defer to a future spousal-imputation fork); Part 8 (Liabilities) at p36 with 14 rows already transcribed by Fork F. The Family Trust shells are NOT formally named on the form (only 'Family Trust 1*' etc.); per Fork G amendment Decision D.3 Path B they are not registered as cp_entity records, only counted via the pooled_investment_instruments / treasury_notes / cash_bank_and_money_market_accounts exclusion buckets. The footer asterisk note reads: '* J.P. Morgan is the sole Trustee. Donald J. Trump retains an income interest only in the Family Trusts and has no investment decision authority.' Trust 2 header row discloses trust-level income as 'Interest, Dividends, Capital Gains: $15,001 - $50,000' (income aggregation at the trust shell rather than per-holding).

categories.rationale: ETFs, mutual funds, and index funds held inside the three J.P. Morgan-managed Family Trusts (Family Trust 1*, 2*, 3*) on Part 6 pp.21-26. J.P. Morgan is sole Trustee; Trump has income interest only and no investment decision authority. The holdings are pooled instruments wrapping diversified equity/bond exposures; the holding is an instrument, not a direct interest in an operating entity. Trust-level income is aggregated at the trust shell (Family Trust 2* header discloses $15,001 - $50,000 in Interest, Dividends, Capital Gains at the trust level rather than per-holding).
US Treasury bond / treasury bond ETF holdings (iShares 3-7 Year Treasury BND, iShares 7-12 Year Treasury BND series) across the three Family Trusts. Government debt instruments.

US bank checking, savings, and money-market accounts disclosed on Part 6 p020 (Trump-direct: JP Morgan Chase, Capital One, Signature Bank, Bank United NA, First Republic Bank = 5 direct entries; WMTMF LLC wrapping a US Bank cash account = 1; DJT Revocable Trust sub-section: Capital One, Professional Bank, Signature Bank, Bank United = 4 trust-held entries) plus the Family Trust 3 US Bank Cash Account on p025 = 1. Not entities for procurement matching.

Pension plan participations disclosed on Part 3 (Filer's Employment Agreements and Arrangements) p017: (1) Screen Actors Guild - Producers Pension Plan for Motion Picture Actors, began 1992, Burbank CA; (2) American Federation of Television and Radio Artists Retirement Fund, began 1989, New York NY. Pension streams from prior film/TV producer career, not held entity stakes.

INVESTMENT IN GOLD line on Part 6 p020 item 6, value bracket $100,001 - $250,000, no income. Direct gold holding (not a commodity-themed investment vehicle wrapper). New bucket added by Fork G §4 per the amendment Decision D.2 methodology addition.

One direct publicly-traded equity holding disclosed on Part 6 p020 via the 'JP MORGAN CLEARING CORP - BROKERAGE ACCOUNT - HOLDINGS' sub-section: Global Fiber Technologies (f/k/a EcoTEK 360, INC. and f/k/a GLOBAL FASHION TECHNOLOGIES), value bracket 'None (or less than $1,001)' with 'None (or less than $201)' income. Trump-direct small passive public-equity holding per the Fork D taxonomy definition.

Trump's residential-asset entities (Trump Park Avenue LLC, 1125 South Ocean LLC, Seven Springs LLC, Trump Tower Triplex) are disclosed on Part 2 as operating entities (not as the holding-LLC-per-unit pattern that drives Jared's 95-entity residential bucket on cp_filing_0001). They get individual cp_entity registrations rather than aggregated bucket treatment.

The 'JPM SHRT INT MUNI BND-CL I' line in Family Trust 1 is an ETF / fund wrapper around munis, not a direct muni-bond holding — captured under pooled_investment_instruments. No standalone direct muni/corp bond lines surface on this filing.
No artwork holdings disclosed on this filing.

Per Fork G §3 amendment §2.7 anomaly #3 ruling: foreign operating entities (Trump-branded foreign golf courses, hotels, etc.) default-include the same way domestic operating entities do, with no separate exclusion or bucket treatment; jurisdiction is a property of the entity, not a reason to bucket it differently. The Trump foreign clubs disclosed on this filing (Trump International Golf Links - Scotland, Trump International Golf Links - Doonbeg, Trump Turnberry, etc.) defer to Fork I full Part 2 Exhibit A backfill alongside the domestic operating entities; none feed this bucket. The Jared-filings foreign_operating_entities bucket (7 DT-* manager LLCs) was a narrower fit; that taxonomy entry stays available but no cp_filing_0003 row uses it.
Mortgages on the filer's primary personal residence; excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(i). No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

Loans secured by a personal motor vehicle, household furniture, or appliances (unless the loan exceeds the item's purchase price); excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(ii). No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

Credit card and revolving charge account balances under $10,000 outstanding to a single creditor at the end of the reporting period; excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(iii). No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

Interpersonal loans from a spouse, parent, sibling, or child of the filer (natural-person counterparty only); excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(iv). Does NOT apply to entity-mediated debt (e.g., loans from a family-controlled trust or LLC), which are written as normal debt_instrument_owed edges per Convention 5. No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

notes: Donald J. Trump's 2021 Termination Public Financial Disclosure Report. Filed as of his term end on 2021-01-20. Used in this hand-population pass to exercise the trust beneficial interest pattern via The Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust as an intermediate cp_entity. All derived relationships are excluded_from_total under the pre-2025 PROJECT.md scope; Trump himself is not a named family member per PROJECT.md's exhaustive list (which covers family members of the administration, not the President himself), so this filing is included for schema-test purposes only, not as live-tracker data. Fork G (2026-05-23) extended the registry coverage of this filing: registered 18 new cp_entity records (12 Fork H Part 8 prep borrowing entities + 3 Over-$50M-only Part 2 entities + The Fred C. Trump December 16, 1976 Trust + 2 Trump-direct Part 6 operating LLCs WMTMF/MBWT), wrote 11 new edges (10 Over-$50M family_to_entity-via-trust-intermediate ownership edges + 1 family_to_entity trust_beneficial edge for the 1976 Trust), and populated _excluded_categories with 14 buckets per Fork D pattern. cp_filing_0003 Part 8 (14 rows) remains deferred to Fork H, which adds the entity_to_entity debt edge schema and writes the deferred rows using the entities registered here. Part 2 Exhibit A full backfill (~80-90 operating entities including 12 remaining Over-$50M rows) plus the 4 Trump-direct Part 6 LLCs without edges (WMTMF, MBWT, and implicit follow-up for the DJT Revocable Trust cash accounts) defer to Fork I. Part 5 (Melania) 6 spouse-imputed entities defer to a future fork (Fork J).
